title: S.B. 365 — Fostering Access, Innovation, and Responsibility in Artificial Intelligence Act; established.
mechanism: A developer of a base artificial intelligence model shall disclose in its terms of service the model name, developer, place of incorporation, latest release date, training data update date, supported languages and a terms of service link. Providing the disclosure shall not be a defense to liability for any harm caused to a plaintiff. Creates the FAIR AI Enforcement Fund for state agency enforcement. In actions over harm, it shall not be a defense that the AI system autonomously caused the harm.
thresholds: Capability-based, no figure: "a large-scale artificial intelligence system model trained on broad and diverse data to learn general patterns and relationships"
